status: Fixed before pilot sampling; exploratory, not preregistration; stop after smoke for review

model.readout_initialization: W independent normal sd sqrt(2/(9+32)); v normal sd sqrt(2/(32+1)); b and c zero; RNG draws a, W, v in that order

training.prior: four independent Uniform[0,1) rows; independent uniform initial pair
training.data_draw_order: p shape(batch,4), initial integers shape(batch), then M random(batch) transition arrays
training.edit_objective: 0.5 clean CE + 0.5 maximum CE over identity and nine structured block proposals

attacks.training: identity; for start 0,floor((M-k)/2),M-k, each overwrite0,overwrite1,flip of length k
attacks.heldout: identity; same three operations on starts floor((M-k)/4),floor(3*(M-k)/4), and sparse distinct floor(linspace(0,M-1,k)) positions
attacks.selection: maximize CE(B(clean_word),predictor(candidate)); first-index tie; no source table or future label

evaluation.metrics: conditional clean CE against B and excess KL; actual-source TV; stress normalized by max(M^-0.5,k/M); approximate pointwise MC SE, no minimax upper or significance claim
evaluation.max_source_scope: finite-panel descriptive maximum only; no asymptotic slope fit

stop: One 200-step, one-seed smoke run of each condition; report all outputs and calibration failures before expansion
limits: No worst-case or all-source learning guarantee
Only finite float64 computation, no finite-bit theorem
Single seed and small sample exploratory smoke
